entries.name: linear:agent
entries.intent: Configure and operate Linear agents (AIG) — agent interaction, agent signals, OAuth actor authorization

entries.name: linear:assign
entries.intent: Assign or reassign Linear issues; supports single, bulk, and round-robin assignment strategies

entries.name: linear:attachment
entries.intent: Upload files to Linear, link external URLs as attachments, and download/inspect existing attachments

entries.name: linear:comment
entries.intent: Comment on issues, reply in threads, add reactions; supports markdown editor features and customer-request linkage

entries.name: linear:customer
entries.intent: Manage customers and customer requests — link to issues, track aggregate demand, route to teams

entries.name: linear:cycle
entries.intent: Plan, update, and report on Linear cycles (sprints) — velocity, scope changes, carry-over

entries.name: linear:diff
entries.intent: Compute and render diffs of Linear issues, projects, or cycles between two points in time

entries.name: linear:documents
entries.intent: Manage Linear issue documents and project documents — create, update, link, and version

entries.name: linear:harness-git
entries.intent: Harness Git Experience integration — bidirectional repo sync, signed commits, OAuth, auto-creation, rate-limit best practices, git cache, environments-as-code

entries.name: linear:harness-platform
entries.intent: Harness Platform automation — API keys/JWT, custom approvals, tags, triggers, variables/expressions, connectors (YAML), authentication

entries.name: linear:harness-sync
entries.intent: Two-way sync between Linear issues and Harness Code repositories — branches, PRs, deploys, and reviews

entries.name: linear:initiative
entries.intent: Manage Linear initiatives and sub-initiatives — strategic groupings of projects with their own status updates

entries.name: linear:issue
entries.intent: Create, edit, select, delete Linear issues with full feature support — sub-issues, templates, labels, priority, estimates, due dates

entries.name: linear:mcp
entries.intent: Install, configure, and operate the Linear MCP server for Claude Code

entries.name: linear:planner-sync
entries.intent: Two-way sync between Linear issues and Microsoft Planner tasks via Microsoft Graph delta queries

entries.name: linear:project
entries.intent: Manage Linear projects — create, milestone planning, status updates, templates, overview, and documents

entries.name: linear:query
entries.intent: Run arbitrary GraphQL queries with cursor pagination, filtering DSL, and complexity-budget rate limiting

entries.name: linear:relations
entries.intent: Manage issue relations — blocks, blocked-by, duplicate, related, and parent/child

entries.name: linear:setup
entries.intent: Configure Linear authentication (API key + OAuth 2.0 + actor authorization), install Linear MCP server, register webhooks, and wire up Harness/Planner bridges

entries.name: linear:sla
entries.intent: Manage SLA policies, monitor breach risk, and surface escalations

entries.name: linear:team
entries.intent: Manage Linear teams, members, default team pages, and team settings

entries.name: linear:triage
entries.intent: Manage the Linear triage queue — list, route, accept, decline, and configure auto-triage rules

entries.name: linear:webhook
entries.intent: Register, verify, replay, and dead-letter Linear webhooks

entries.name: linear:workflow
entries.intent: Configure team workflow states, transitions, and SLA-driven escalations
